why: Lint cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/lint-1.md, P1 lint-1.2): src/lint/blanket-disable.ts exists so the weakened-config check can find a file-level disable that silences basalt/waiver-needs-reason itself (guardrails section 7, check 3), but nothing outside its own test calls findBlanketDisables. In a scratch app, `/* oxlint-disable */` at the top of a file (and the same with `-- legacy screen`, and `/* eslint-disable */`) made basalt-ui lint report no findings and basalt-ui doctor report no weakened guard. examples/react/src/components/tremor/AreaChart.tsx carries one today.
what: doctor's weakened-config check reports every source file under a declared root whose file-level directive silences waiver-needs-reason.
must_not_touch: packages/basalt-ui/src/lint/blanket-disable.ts (its detector is right; it is unwired)
change: Check 3 (managed-ids) of checkWeakenedConfig reads every scannable source file under each declared root (the files basalt-ui lint scans) and runs findBlanketDisables over it; each hit is a failure naming `<file>:<line>` and the reach (`every rule` or `waiver-needs-reason`), with the fix: waive the line with a reason, or declare the path in manifest.deepRender and name one of the three file-waivable ids. Test: a root holding a file that opens with `/* oxlint-disable */` fails check 3 with that file and line; the same file with `/* oxlint-disable basalt/colour-literal -- canvas */` passes check 3.
proof: bun test on weakened.test.ts and guards.test.ts; in a scratch app built by docs/v3/cycles/lint-1/fixtures/run.sh, a file opening with `/* oxlint-disable */` makes doctor check 11 fail and name the file.
acceptance: A bare `/* oxlint-disable */` under a declared root fails doctor and names file and line (test)
An `/* eslint-disable */` is found the same way (test)
A file-level directive naming only other rules passes check 3 (test)
